claims.claim: The Konica Minolta Bizhub Pro C754e is a large, full colour, laser multifunctional printer.
claims.evidence: Witness report identifies it as a large office multifunction copier/printer with scanner bed and paper output tray, and the front label shows “bizhub PRO” and “C754e”. The report does not show it is full-colour or laser specifically, nor any powered-on operation.
Photo 0 front lower-left label shows “bizhub PRO” and “C754e”.

risks.risk: Not tested/powers on: could be dead, stuck in error state, or have controller/engine faults.
risks.proof: A short video/clip of the machine powering on from cold, reaching the home screen, and showing no error codes (including a quick menu navigation).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not confirmed working (worst-case: needs servicing/repair).

risks.risk: Print/copy quality unknown (toner/laser/transfer issues, banding, streaks).
risks.proof: A sample print/copy output clip showing a test page (or a photo of a freshly printed test page) with readable text and even color coverage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown quality (worst-case: may require toner/maintenance).

risks.risk: High usage / near end-of-life components (fuser, drums, transfer belt, rollers).
risks.proof: A photo of the internal meter/page count screen (or a settings page showing total pages) and any maintenance counters.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as high-usage risk (worst-case: major consumables may be due).

risks.risk: Consumables/toner/drums levels and whether included are unknown.
risks.proof: Photos of toner/drum status indicators (or a screen showing remaining levels) plus what consumables are physically included in the deal.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as consumables not guaranteed (worst-case: buyer must replace).

risks.risk: Missing trays/parts or incomplete configuration (paper trays, bypass, finishers).
risks.proof: A full photo walkthrough showing all installed trays (tray numbers/sizes if visible) and any missing/removed modules; include a shot of the rear and sides.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as base unit only (worst-case: missing trays/modules).

risks.risk: Connectivity/driver readiness unknown (USB/Ethernet/Wi‑Fi, network port status).
risks.proof: A clip showing network settings page (IP/connection status) and/or a USB/Ethernet connection test with a successful print.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as connectivity not confirmed (worst-case: buyer may need setup/extra parts).

risks.risk: Physical wear/damage not visible (scratches, dents, leaks, worn rollers) could affect reliability.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of high-wear areas: paper feed rollers, fuser area access panels (if safe), underside/edges, and any visible dents/leaks.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as average used condition (worst-case: hidden wear).

proof_requests: Power-on video from cold with no error codes and the machine reaching the home screen.
A test print/copy sample page (photo or short clip) showing clear text and color consistency.
Photo of the total page count/meter and any maintenance counters.
Photos/screens showing toner/drum/consumable levels and what is included in the sale.
Photos showing all paper trays installed (and any missing trays/modules), plus rear/side views.
Connectivity proof: network settings screen (IP/connection) and a successful print from a phone/laptop via the stated method.
response.reason: The witness can identify the exact model (Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e) from the front label, so the item can be priced at its worst-case used reliability. However, operation, meters, consumables, and faults are not shown, so the price should assume potential servicing/consumables needs until proven otherwise.
